contents.name: §3.1.2 Galerkin for NSE, Definition 3.1
contents.support: Supports the finite-dimensional solenoidal projection and coefficient-ODE formulation. The local definition supplies explicit normalized measure and all coefficient integrals.

contents.name: §3.2 The existence proof, Theorem 3.4 proof Steps 1–2
contents.support: Derives the finite coefficient system, invokes local Picard–Lindelof existence, cancels the periodic convection term using exact incompressibility, obtains the energy bound, and states the conclusion T_N=∞. Its continuation argument is compact; the local proof supplies the full continuation details for an arbitrary finite smooth basis and includes the zero-viscosity endpoint by direct algebra.

contents.name: §3.2 Steps after the finite-dimensional estimate: compactness and passage to weak PDE solutions
contents.reason: The assigned theorem concerns only the finite coefficient ODE; it asserts no convergence of Galerkin approximations and no existence or uniqueness theorem for the full PDE.

contents.name: §5 Fourier projection and the finite Galerkin coefficient system, (5.24)–(5.28)
contents.support: Supports the divergence-free Fourier projection and finite quadratic coefficient ODE; the authored definition states a general finite smooth orthonormal solenoidal family.

contents.name: §5 Energy bound for Galerkin solutions, (5.29)–(5.35)
contents.support: Shows the projected convection is energy-neutral for divergence-free periodic fields, bounds finite-dimensional coefficients, and states that finite-time ODE loss cannot occur except through energy blow-up. The authored proof gives the exact skew-tensor computation and full continuation argument.
